meta.title: A vendor who never bid cannot be awarded
gaps: The plan cannot specify awarding one unit because no writable quantity field is available for award_vendor.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Awarded vendor is not present in the latest stage”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A vendor who never bid cannot be awarded

expected.message: Awarded vendor is not present in the latest stage
